name: 新黑色电影
label: 新黑色电影
palette: 深黑、烟灰、钨丝琥珀与一点冷青，局部高饱和红色作为叙事重音
lighting: 低调布光，硬质侧光与百叶窗切光，强烈明暗分区，湿地反光与背光轮廓
optics: 35mm/50mm anamorphic feel, shallow depth of field, subtle halation, controlled gate weave
composition: 斜线构图、前景遮挡、镜面与门框形成窥视层次，人物置于负空间的边缘
camera_motion: slow push-in, lateral track, restrained handheld drift; let the camera reveal information rather than chase it
style_instructions: Live-action neo-noir crime drama, tactile production design, practical locations, expressive shadows, precise blocking, cinematic still frame.
avoid_instructions: No glossy music-video look, no neon overload, no plastic skin, no comic-book rendering, no text or watermark.

video.video_prompt: Keep the low-key lighting and motivated practical sources; use a slow investigative camera move, one clear subject action, and a decisive visual reveal.

nanobanana.image_prompt: Prioritize readable silhouettes, practical light sources, and a controlled pool of highlight against deep shadow.
